question: What bodily and perceptual powers result from mastery of this wheel?
premises: Destruction of wrinkles and grey hair is named
Seeing from very far away is named
These are presented as parallel accomplishments
inference: Mastery brings removal of wrinkles and grey hair and the power to see from very far away.
plain_english: It brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the power to see from very far away.
